stages.name: Relaciónate y Punto
stages.desc: Born in Córdoba as an editorial project on international affairs and foreign trade, formally incorporated as RELACIONATEYPUNTO, S.L. in January 2021 by Mar Gámez Ramírez and Mar Ramírez.

stages.name: RRYP Abogados & expansion
stages.desc: First physical office in Córdoba (March 2023), Top 50 Company Award by Andalucía Emprende, national television commentary on laSexta Noticias, entry into La Nave Madrid and workshops in Promálaga and EUDE.

stages.name: RRYP Global — International Legal Boutique
stages.desc: Consolidation across 3 real offices (Madrid, Málaga and Córdoba), lecturing at Loyola University, press coverage in La Razón and Diario Córdoba, 200+ matters, 26+ nationalities and RRYP Legal Intelligence.

timeline.title: An international affairs publication that sparked a legal boutique
timeline.desc: Mar Gámez Ramírez (Dual Degree in Law and International Relations at Loyola University, LL.M. at ISDE) and Mar Ramírez launch Relaciónate y Punto, focused on foreign trade, geopolitics and practical international law.

timeline.title: Incorporation of RELACIONATEYPUNTO, S.L. in Córdoba
timeline.desc: Formal incorporation of RELACIONATEYPUNTO, S.L. (Tax ID B42713768, Commercial Registry of Córdoba) backed by CADE Córdoba and Andalucía Emprende, delivering internationalisation consulting and cross-border legal advice.

timeline.title: RRYP Global opens its first physical office in Córdoba
timeline.desc: Legal publication Law&Trends covers the opening of the firm's first office in Córdoba (Avda. Sta. Mª de Trassierra 98), consolidating the RRYP Global brand as an international legal boutique.

timeline.title: Top 50 Company Award by Andalucía Emprende
timeline.desc: Andalucía Emprende (Regional Public Foundation under the Ministry of University, Research and Innovation) selects RRYP among the Top 50 innovative companies for its technological focus and entrepreneurial impact.

timeline.title: First appearance on laSexta Noticias and analysis in Deutsche Welle
timeline.desc: On 27 August 2023 Mar Gámez appears on national TV (laSexta) and is quoted by Deutsche Welle regarding the legal and trade impact of Panama Canal restrictions, followed by Al-Ándalus Innovation Venture, Córdoba Biotech and Andalucía TRADE Global.

timeline.title: Joining La Nave Madrid, IMDEEC institutional backing and Málaga presence
timeline.desc: In February 2024 RRYP joins #EcosistemaLN at La Nave Madrid (Madrid City Council) and hosts IMDEEC in Córdoba, followed by an alliance with AJE Córdoba, Born Global Startup seminars at EUDE Madrid and workshops at Promálaga.

timeline.title: Second national TV briefing on laSexta covering the Red Sea crisis
timeline.desc: Mar Gámez returns to laSexta Noticias to assess the legal, contractual and logistics fallout of the Red Sea shipping attacks on international maritime trade.

timeline.title: «Pienso, Luego Éxito» podcast, 1st Legal Café and La Razón coverage
timeline.desc: Following AI trade training for IPRODECO and sponsoring the AJE Córdoba and AJE Málaga Awards, RRYP launches its «Pienso, Luego Éxito» podcast and Legal Cafés. On 28 July La Razón reports the court admission of a cross-border fraud complaint led by the firm.

timeline.title: Diario Córdoba profile, Loyola University lecturing and Málaga Chamber of Commerce
timeline.desc: On 18 August Diario Córdoba publishes an in-depth interview on the firm's expansion from Córdoba to nearly 30 countries. In September Mar Gámez joins Loyola University as Associate Professor of Private International Law and speaks on AI compliance at the Málaga Chamber of Commerce.

timeline.title: Three real offices, 200+ cross-border matters and RRYP Legal Intelligence
timeline.desc: Operating from Madrid (Pº de la Castellana 40), Málaga (C/ Martínez Campos 16, also serving Marbella and the Costa del Sol) and Córdoba (Avda. Sta. Mª de Trassierra 98), the firm directs Private Clients, Private Wealth, Business Disputes and Economic Crime / EAW matters, backed by 429 legal analyses, 28 representative cases and multilingual AI.

faqs.q: Does RRYP Global handle matters like mine?
faqs.a: The firm acts in international family law, cross-border wealth and estates, international corporate matters, cross-border litigation and economic crime. The first consultation confirms exact fit.

faqs.q: Who will personally direct my matter if engaged?
faqs.a: Our engagement proposal identifies the lead lawyer, the team assigned and the decisions reserved for Legal Direction. On matters directed by Mar Gámez Ramírez, she oversees strategy, critical decisions and supervision.

faqs.q: Can you coordinate lawyers and advisers in other countries?
faqs.a: Yes. We direct proceedings in Spain and coordinate foreign counsel, tax advisers, notaries and experts across all relevant jurisdictions.

faqs.q: What documentation should I share beforehand?
faqs.a: A short chronology, the countries involved, any urgent deadline and key documents are ideal. You do not need to send the entire file upfront.

faqs.q: What happens after the first meeting?
faqs.a: We confirm whether further legal action or formal representation is appropriate and, if so, send a tailored proposal setting out scope, legal direction and fees.

faqs.q: What if the firm cannot accept or assess my matter?
faqs.a: If a conflict of interest is detected prior to the meeting or the matter cannot be properly assessed, the booking is cancelled and refunded in full.

faqs.q: What kind of matters does RRYP Global accept?
faqs.a: We take on complex matters connected to Spain involving multiple jurisdictions, significant assets, business disputes, international family law or litigation. We do not try to be a generalist firm.
Legal direction rests with Mar Gámez, supported by our team and foreign counsel wherever cross-border coordination is required.

faqs.q: Do you work alongside lawyers in other countries?
faqs.a: Yes. Whenever foreign law or parallel filings abroad are needed, RRYP coordinates the unified strategy so proceedings never work against one another.

faqs.q: Can you take over a matter already handled by another firm?
faqs.a: Yes. We audit everything done to date and rebuild the strategic position from which to move forward.

faqs.q: What happens in the first legal meeting?
faqs.a: It is a working legal session with Mar Gámez analysing facts, key documents, jurisdictions involved and objectives. Fee: €350.

faqs.q: How are subsequent legal fees structured?
faqs.a: According to complexity, scope and execution requirements. Scope and fees are agreed transparently before any mandate begins.

faqs.q: Do I need to know the exact legal route before contacting you?
faqs.a: No. Simply explain what is happening; legal qualification is part of our work.

sections.title: Academic background
sections.p1: Graduated in Law and International Relations at Jesuit Universidad Loyola, where she was inducted into Alpha Sigma Nu, the honour society recognizing academic excellence and personal merit.
sections.p2: Completed her Postgraduate Bar Admission Degree specializing in Corporate Law and International Business at ISDE and Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, alongside an LL.M. in International Business Law, Contracting and International Relations at ISDE.

sections.title: Professional practice & Bar admission
sections.p1: Co-founding Partner and Legal Director of RRYP Global, leading high-complexity cross-border matters across international family law, private wealth, estates, corporate litigation and economic crime.
sections.p2: Admitted to the Madrid Bar Association as a practising lawyer (ICAM no. 137007) after achieving top marks in the Spanish Bar exam. Her background includes international corporate practice and legal direction of entrepreneurial ventures.

sections.title: Academic teaching & publications
sections.p1: Associate Professor at Universidad Loyola, lecturing weekly in Private International Law and Comparative Law, and guest lecturer at EOI, IMDEEC and IPRODECO.
sections.p2: Contributing author for the Aranzadi Thomson Reuters International Trade Law programme on international contracting, guarantees, trade finance and dispute resolution. Practises fluently in Spanish and English.

sections.title: Research, speaking & media
sections.p1: Her research covers China–EU dispute resolution mechanisms, international joint ventures and business internationalisation. Regular speaker at the Chambers of Commerce of Málaga, Tenerife and Colombia, EOI, Loyola University, EUDE Business School and Promálaga.
sections.p2: Appears regularly as an international legal analyst on laSexta Noticias, Deutsche Welle and La Razón.
